breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the factor-of-safety condition: designing against buckling requires the critical load to exceed n times the applied load, not the applied load divided by n.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the factor-of-safety condition as P_cr ≥ n·P (i.e., 60000 N), ignoring the incorrect instruction in the incomplete prompt that said to use P_cr ≥ P/n. This matches the ground truth requirement.
